findings.title: The labels on the floor plan are very small

location.description: The bay labels P1 to R6 inside the plan card on the right.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer has to lean in to read which bay is which, though the labels are the only way to tell the bays apart.

current.value: Each bay label is set in about 11 pixel type in the top corner of its tile.

findings.target: Bay labels are as easy to read as the plan card's heading line.
findings.fix_direction: Increase the size of the bay labels so they can be read without leaning in.
findings.source: WCAG 2.2, understanding of text size and readability (SC 1.4.4 and general guidance)

closed_when.check: Look at the plan card and check that the bay labels can be read at normal reading distance.

findings.title: The three feature notes sit below a large empty gap

location.description: The row of three short notes under the thin rule, at the bottom of the page.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer finishes at the plan and the main button, and the three notes below are easy to miss.

current.value: The three notes are set in small type under a hairline, with a large empty area below them.

findings.target: The three notes read as a deliberate part of the page.
findings.fix_direction: Give the row of notes a clearer place in the reading order.

closed_when.check: Look at the lower part of the page and check that the three notes read as part of the page.
